properties.displayName: FW-009 Firewall - Inbound connection allowed from a restricted country
properties.description: Detects inbound connections from public IPs located in a restricted country that the firewall allowed (FortiGate accept/close/timeout, Palo Alto allow). If your policy is to block these countries, any allowed session means a geo-blocking gap or a misconfigured rule. Country comes from the FortiGate srccountry field when present, otherwise from Sentinel's geo_info_from_ip_address().
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
// EXAMPLE list only. Replace with your organisation's or customer's restricted-country policy.
// Add every spelling your data uses (run the country check in docs/data-sources.md).
let RestrictedCountries = dynamic([
    "North Korea", "Korea, Democratic People's Republic of",
    "Iran", "Iran, Islamic Republic of",
    "Syria", "Syrian Arab Republic",
    "Cuba"
]);
// FortiGate logs allowed sessions as accept/close/timeout/*-rst; Palo Alto uses allow
let AllowedActions = dynamic(["accept", "allow", "close", "timeout", "server-rst", "client-rst"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and not(ipv4_is_private(SourceIP))
| where tolower(DeviceAction) in (AllowedActions)
| extend SourceCountry = coalesce(
    extract(@"FTNTFGTsrccountry=([^;]+)", 1, AdditionalExtensions),
    tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(SourceIP).country))
| where SourceCountry in~ (RestrictedCountries)
| summarize
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),
    SessionCount = count(),
    DestinationIPs = make_set(DestinationIP, 25),
    DestinationPorts = make_set(DestinationPort, 25),
    Actions = make_set(DeviceAction, 10),
    BytesSent = sum(SentBytes),
    BytesReceived = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    FirewallName = take_any(DeviceName)
    by SourceIP, SourceCountry, DeviceVendor
| project StartTime, EndTime, SourceIP, SourceCountry, SessionCount, DestinationIPs, DestinationPorts, Actions, BytesSent, BytesReceived, DeviceVendor, FirewallName

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: The firewall allowed {{SessionCount}} inbound session(s) from {{SourceIP}} in restricted country {{SourceCountry}}.
